items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: he was really good, played with Jon Hendricks and a lot of different people around here in the sixties and seventies.

ctx.x: But there was a musician that, he passed a few years ago, a great, great pianist named Flip Nunez, a Filipino. And I used to work a lot with him and he was really good, played with Jon Hendricks and a lot of different people around here in the sixties and seventies. And then there was another one, a Filipino musician I played a lot with named George Mirabis, another pianist, a great musician. So there is of course Latin musicians, a lot of big Latin musicians, so it’s pretty diverse around here.
What’s your opinion of smooth jazz?
